name: Easy Pose
description: A simple cross-legged seat: shins crossed, each foot under the opposite knee, knees wide, hands resting on the knees and the spine tall.

source.title: Easy Pose (Yoga Journal)
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Sit on the floor, or on a folded blanket so your hips are above your knees.
Cross your shins with each foot under the opposite knee.

keyframes.name: Sit in Staff Pose
keyframes.cue: Sit tall with the legs straight out in front.

keyframes.name: Easy Pose
keyframes.cue: Cross your shins, each foot under the opposite knee. Hands on your knees; sit tall.

cues: Weight even on both sit bones.
Knees lower than your hips: sit on a folded blanket if they are higher.
Crown of the head up; shoulders soft.
Change which shin is in front next time.
